note: P4350 (Pro 29:17) — discipline your son, and he will give you rest and delight your heart.

dims.v: peace — the rest and delight a well-corrected son brings
the rest and heart's delight a disciplined son gives his parent — the peace of mind and joy that loving correction yields, the reward of not withholding the rod
(the delight to the heart that accompanies it)
the peace and gladness a well-raised child brings

nuach (rest) — 'discipline your son, and he will give you REST; he will give delight to your heart' (cf 29:15; 10:1); correction rightly given yields a son who brings peace and joy, not shame. Discipline is an investment in a parent's future rest.
